{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Way''' was a region of space within the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. It was heavily patrolled by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
